        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    inv_remaining = 1.0 / (remaining + 1e-8)
    weights = np.exp(item / (bins + 1e-8))
    weights /= np.sum(weights) + 1e-8
    priorities = -inv_remaining * (1.0 + weights)
    return np.where(valid, priorities, -np.inf)
